description: Aave V4 spoke liquidation-config history. Returns the current targetHealthFactor / healthFactorForMaxBonus / liquidationBonusFactor for a spoke and its full snapshot history (one row per governance update). Use for: auditing parameter drift, modeling how config changes affected liquidation behavior, governance-trail reporting. Data AaveKit's REST API doesn't expose.
name: get_v4_spoke_config_history
